uca_sentences: A man wearing a black hat and a black vest threatens the man wearing a white hat behind the counter to withdraw money from the counter
The man in the black hat took the money and left, the man at the counter raised his hands

witness_A.viewpoint: close by, inside, a few metres away
witness_A.statement: I was inside the store when I saw a man wearing a black hat and a black vest. He was threatening the man behind the counter, who was wearing a white hat and raised his hands. The robber took some money from the counter.

witness_B.viewpoint: far away, looking in from outside
witness_B.statement: I saw a man who robbed the place. He was wearing a red vest and took the money. I think he threatened the man behind the counter, but I'm not sure. The man behind the counter was being robbed.

witness_C.statement: I saw a man who robbed the place. He was wearing a black hat and a black vest. He threatened the man behind the counter and then left. I think he was wearing a black vest. Another man, wearing a grey coat, was just nearby.
